Package ca.refundr.highspring.api.resource

Class AbstractChildResource<P extends AbstractResource>

java.lang.Object
ca.refundr.highspring.api.resource.AbstractResource
ca.refundr.highspring.api.resource.AbstractChildResource<P>
Type Parameters:
P - parent resource type (for clarity when reading call sites)
Direct Known Subclasses:
AdminAllureResource, AdminAllureResource.AdminAllureFileResource, AdminBoomResource, AdminErrorsResource, AdminErrorsResource.AdminErrorResource, AdminJavadocResource, AdminJavadocResource.AdminJavadocFileResource, AdminPurchasesResource, AdminResource, AdminTotalsResource, AuthE2eLoginResource, AuthLogoutResource, AuthResource, CartResource, CartResource.CartCheckoutResource, CartResource.CartItemsResource, GoogleAuthCallbackResource, GoogleAuthUrlResource, MeResource, ProductsResource, PurchasesResource, PurchasesResource.PurchaseResource, Version1Resource
public abstract class AbstractChildResource<P extends AbstractResource> extends AbstractResource
A resource that lives under a parent path.

Example: ProductsResource is a child of Version1Resource, so the full URL is / + v1/ + products/ → /v1/products/.

Keeping a typed parent pointer makes the tree easy to navigate in the debugger and documents which API section you are in (auth under auth, admin under admin, …).
